purpose: RC3 review-only routing that fails closed when plausible identity misuse has incomplete identity, authorization, provenance, or authenticity evidence

rules.condition: A current account, transaction, access, benefit, communication, or victim-impact act is paired with unauthorized use of another person's identity, information, credentials, or account.

A current profile, message, listing, caller, or account deceptively poses as a person, government entity, business, or representative and includes an account-use, contact, access, transaction, or victim-impact act.
Natural first-person and reordered forms satisfy the same two-part evidence contract only when deceptive identity and active misuse are both present.
Plausible identity misuse fails closed when identity, authorization, consent, provenance, authenticity, deceptive intent, source availability, or evidence completeness is unresolved.
Documented authorization, an owner-approved representative, or a platform-verified official account is established without contradictory evidence.
Clearly labelled parody, satire, fan content, role-play, fiction, reporting, education, prevention, research, or victim-recovery guidance has no active deception or identity misuse.
A name, face, photograph, voice, logo, resemblance, self-claim, or model prediction alone cannot establish identity, authorization, account ownership, deception, or impersonation.
